profile.name: Souvik Roy
profile.headline: Powering Robots
profile.intro: Building robot perception, control, and learning systems. From vision-guided manipulation to sim-to-real transfer for quadruped and humanoid robots.
profile.footer: Robotics engineer working at the intersection of perception, control, and AI.
about: I’m a Robotics Engineer at EVO in Viseu, Portugal, building perception, control, and reinforcement and imitation learning systems for quadruped and humanoid robots, with a focus on sim-to-real transfer.

I hold a master’s degree in Advanced Robotics from École Centrale de Nantes. Previously, I developed a vision-based positioning system for remote-handling robots at ITER, and led technical vision and R&D at ME3D.
My interests span motion planning and control, computer vision, and reinforcement learning. I enjoy solving engineering problems that connect robotics research with real-world deployment.

experience.description: Building robot perception, control, and reinforcement and imitation learning systems, with a focus on sim-to-real transfer for quadruped and humanoid robots.
Led the technical vision and R&D for a deep-tech platform applying AI-driven spatial intelligence to fashion e-commerce.

Developed a high-precision vision-based positioning system for remote-handling robots. Worked on fiducial detection, 6DoF pose estimation, stereo and hand–eye calibration, and vision-to-robot integration.
Developed a Python application for inertial parameter identification on a Franka Emika robot using recursive Newton–Euler dynamics, least-squares optimization, and SVD.
Built statistical and predictive models and automated data preparation workflows using Python and SQL.

education.description: Robot programming, computer vision, artificial intelligence, optimization, kinematics and dynamics, and mobile robotics.
Control systems, signal processing, power electronics, neural networks, and digital and analog electronics.

projects.title: Perception-Driven Mobile Robot Control
projects.summary: A ROS 2 control architecture combining camera and LiDAR perception for waypoint navigation and obstacle avoidance in Gazebo.
projects.overview: Designed and implemented a ROS 2-based control architecture integrating camera and LiDAR perception in Gazebo Fortress simulation environments.
contributions: Integrated perception with closed-loop control for waypoint navigation and dynamic obstacle avoidance.
Used ROS 2 Navigation2 for mission planning and execution.
Packaged the system in Docker for reproducibility.

projects.title: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction & Detection
projects.summary: A hybrid vision pipeline combining multi-view reconstruction, object detection, and 6DoF pose estimation.
projects.overview: Combined OpenCV, COLMAP, and PyTorch to reconstruct scenes from multiple views and detect objects within a vision pipeline.
contributions: Implemented YOLOv11 for object detection and PnP-based 6DoF pose estimation.
Generated dense point clouds from stereo inputs.
Validated the pipeline using custom datasets and open benchmarks.

projects.title: Stereo Visual SLAM with ORB-SLAM3
projects.summary: Stereo-camera localization and mapping, integrated with ROS 2 navigation and evaluated on KITTI and EuRoC datasets.
projects.overview: Configured and optimized ORB-SLAM3 for real-time localization and mapping with stereo camera inputs.
contributions: Worked with loop-closure detection and map optimization for trajectory estimation.
Integrated SLAM outputs with ROS 2 navigation modules.
Benchmarked performance on KITTI and EuRoC datasets.

projects.title: Robotics Vision Deployment on AWS
projects.summary: An end-to-end workflow for training, deploying, and monitoring computer vision models for robotics applications.
projects.overview: Developed an MLOps pipeline for deploying computer vision models in robotics applications using AWS and Docker.
contributions: Used AWS S3, EC2, and Lambda for training, deployment, and monitoring workflows.
Integrated CI/CD workflows for reproducible deployment.
